faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about hosting with Bubu Cloud
faq.answer1: Bubu Cloud is a hosting provider built for gamers, developers and growing projects. We offer Minecraft, VPS, web and bot hosting on fast NVMe infrastructure with DDoS protection and 24/7 support.
faq.question2: Do you support Minecraft Java and Bedrock?
faq.answer2: Yes. Every Minecraft plan supports both Java and Bedrock editions, with instant setup and a modern control panel to manage your world.
faq.question3: Can I install plugins and mods?
faq.answer3: Absolutely. Our Minecraft control panel supports one-click plugin and mod installation, along with full file access for custom setups.
faq.answer4: Yes, every server on Bubu Cloud — Minecraft, VPS, web or bot — includes enterprise-grade DDoS protection at no extra cost.
faq.question5: Can I upgrade my plan later?
faq.answer5: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from your client area. Upgrades apply instantly without losing your data.
faq.answer6: All plans include automated backups, and you can also trigger manual backups at any time from your control panel.
faq.question7: Which VPS operating systems are available?
faq.answer7: Our VPS plans support Ubuntu, Debian, AlmaLinux and Rocky Linux, with more images available on request.
faq.answer8: Our support team is available 24/7 through our ticket system and Discord community for fast, expert help.
faq.question9: How quickly is my server deployed?
faq.answer9: Most servers deploy instantly after payment. Minecraft and bot hosting servers are typically ready in under 60 seconds.
faq.question10: Can I use my own domain?
faq.answer10: Yes, you can connect your own domain to any web hosting or VPS plan, with free SSL included.
